summary.intent: Address PR review comments on cipher-box PR #318, fixing validation and metrics capture issues in the load test workflow and file workload.
summary.outcome: All three issues were fixed and pushed: client_count validation, metrics capture for file errors, and curl flag correction (-fsS). Both review threads were resolved.

repo: Load test workflow lives at .github/workflows/load-test.yml; file workload at tests/load/src/workloads/file-workload.ts
PR reviews are managed via GitHub review threads that must be explicitly resolved after fixing

code.finding: client_count input lacked validation; must be a positive integer — fail-fast guard added
curl -s silently returns exit 0 on HTTP 5xx; -fsS is required so only 2xx/3xx count as success in health/readiness checks
'file not found' and 'size mismatch' errors must be thrown inside the metrics.measure callback to be captured in error metrics

workflow: GitHub review comments can flag duplicate issues; treat them as valid unless clearly noise
curl flags matter for CI readiness probes: -f causes failure on 4xx/5xx, -s suppresses progress, -S shows errors

friction: A valid duplicate comment in the review (curl -s issue) was initially overlooked and required a separate follow-up fix and commit
